comment: Tool-selection variants for #522 and #523 (docs/tool-cost.md §8): meta and the selection/resident summaries of each run, no raw records.

variants.base: String topic, find_apps deferred (the code before #522/#523)
variants.bh: enum + find_apps loaded + find_apps result hint
variants.ah: enum + pointer a1 + find_apps result hint
variants.final: the chosen change as committed (= ab), a second run

pointers.a1: For another project's apps, use find_apps.
pointers.a2: To use another project's app yourself, call find_apps, then attach_app.
pointers.a3: Not for its apps: find_apps and attach_app give you their tools.
pointers.hint: Attach it here rather than asking that project: attach_app gives this session the app's tools (load attach_app through tool search if it is not loaded).

prompts.comment: The fixed prompt set of scripts/measure-tools.mts (#513). Placeholders: {project} this project's name, {other} the other project's name, {seed} the seeded session's name. A run's JSON keeps the prompts it used; change this file and the two runs no longer compare.
prompts.seed: Note for later, no action needed: for the database backup we decided on pg_dump, nightly at 03:00. Reply with the single word OK.

selection.prompt: How do I let my other Centralu projects use an app from this project?
What does the Speed option under the input box in Centralu do? Only explain it.
Have the {other} project list the files in its top folder, then tell me what it found.
One of my other Centralu projects shares a counter app. What number is it showing now?
Use the counter app from the {other} project to tell me its current number.
Which apps from my other Centralu projects could this session use?
